name: Make My Bracelet — Number Bonds to 10
competency: Mastering number pairs that make 10, finding the missing addend, and spatial grouping
ncertStandard: Grade 1 Mathematics: Joyful Mathematics Chapter 5 (Numbers to 10 & 20)
overview: Riya's 10-bead bracelet broke and beads scattered. Children help her buy or find the exact missing number of beads to complete the bracelet ring without leftovers (N + ? = 10).
learningOutcomes: Identify pairs of numbers that add up to 10 (3+7, 4+6, 5+5, etc.)
Find the unknown addend in an addition equation (a + ? = 10)
Develop tactile spatial understanding using circular bead string manipulatives
Extend number bonds to 20 for advanced learners

levels.name: The Bead Shop
levels.description: Select the correct bead jar from the shop to complete 10 beads

levels.name: Room Hunt Adventure
levels.description: Find hidden beads around the house (table, plant, toy box) and calculate missing beads

levels.name: Master 20-Bead Necklace
levels.description: Construct large 20-bead necklaces with two-digit complements
